queries.name: Revenue Today
queries.query: SELECT sum(total_revenue) as Revenue FROM retail_lakehouse.gold.fact_daily_sales WHERE date_key = current_date()

queries.name: Orders Today
queries.query: SELECT sum(total_orders) as Orders FROM retail_lakehouse.gold.fact_daily_sales WHERE date_key = current_date()

queries.name: Top 10 Products
queries.query: SELECT p.name as product_name, sum(o.order_amount) as total_revenue FROM retail_lakehouse.gold.fact_orders o JOIN retail_lakehouse.gold.dim_products p ON o.product_key = p.product_key GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

queries.name: Revenue by Region
queries.query: SELECT region, sum(total_revenue) as revenue FROM retail_lakehouse.gold.fact_daily_sales GROUP BY region
